excluded: No model, script, texture, formal scene, or Godot project file was changed by this validation.
No UI or live Godot run was started by this validator.

glb_import.method: Imported the delivered GLB into Blender 5.0.1 with a factory-startup session; all required C_BODY, C_SLOT, M01, M01_STAIR, M03_STAIR, M05-D, M09 and M10 material images were embedded.

uv0_native_density.method: Measured every non-zero-area exported GLB triangle with its embedded material dimensions. The metric is sqrt(abs(det(texture-pixel Jacobian / metre))). Triangles with 3D cross-product area below 1e-5 m2 were excluded as collinear fan residuals, for which density is undefined.

M09.note: The 5-pixel-high strip's 78.195 lower reading is the expected low-resolution/quantization edge case (2.26% below target), not a collapsed UV.

uv0_native_density.continuous_C_turn: pass: both C guard sweeps are a single continuous object each; final C_BODY effective-density bounds are 79.998 to 80.002 px/m. The earlier closing-profile strip discontinuity was present in an intermediate export, was reported, and is not present in the hashed final artifact.

recessed_grips.method: Read-only BVH rays from the walkable side at the opening centreline. Each sample hit a dedicated recessed back, not a coplanar front wall face.

clear_width.basis: Delivered GLB bounds: lower y=-0.90..+0.90, upper y=+1.10..+2.90, and turn guard x=+1.65 to turn wall x=+3.45.

source_geometry.method: Compared world-space vertex coordinates and polygon-index sequences of source interior_accessories.blend against the delivered editable blend.
source_geometry.note: All retained tread, landing and L01 core geometry is exact. Only UV0 on copied Lower_ClosedFlight and Upper_ClosedFlight was repaired in this candidate; their vertices and topology remain exact copies. The 44 unretained source names are the rebuilt old wall/backing family, not stair/platform/L01 core geometry.

editable_blend_topology.method: Checked the current editable blend before export, rather than de-indexed GLB import edges.

formal_scene_scope.method: Repository status inspection found no modified tracked formal scene file under scenes/. The only scene introduced by this work is scenes/dev/cryo_handrail_full_v1.tscn.
formal_scene_scope.note: project.godot had an existing local diff before this validation. It is explicitly out of this asset delivery and was neither attributed to nor changed by this validation.

runtime_clearance_record.boundary: The authored record explicitly says this is imported-triangle rays and static capsule poses, not movement-controller or stair-climbing acceptance.

not_tested: Fresh Godot launch, rendering, player-controller traversal and frame-to-frame runtime behavior were not performed by this validator.
No user visual approval is implied by this technical validation.
This is not fire, structural or accessibility certification.
